mapper.insert: INSERT INTO documents (id, file_name, file_type, file_size, status, parse_mode) VALUES (#{id}, #{fileName}, #{fileType}, #{fileSize}, #{status}, #{parseMode})
mapper.select: SELECT id, file_name, file_type, file_size, status, parse_mode, error_message, parent_count, child_count, created_at, updated_at FROM documents WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, file_name, file_type, file_size, status, parse_mode, error_message, parent_count, child_count, created_at, updated_at FROM documents ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE documents SET parent_count = #{parentCount}, child_count = #{childCount}, status = #{status}, error_message = NULL WHERE id = #{id}
